name: Hisense SmartTV 4K FFM (Google TV 12)
summary: Hisense SmartTV 4K FFM (Google TV 12) ships with telemetry and demo mode. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and undo.
intro: This Hisense SmartTV 4K FFM from Mongolia runs Google TV 12. It ships with Hisense telemetry, Google tracking and feedback, preloaded apps, store and hotel demo mode, a first-time setup flow and streaming apps that can go. The list has 17 apps in groups.

It was applied in four batches with a restart and a screenshot after each, with a normal boot and no crashes. The HDMI input, Wi-Fi and the remote's buttons kept working. TidyTV turns these off from your phone with a backup first and deletes nothing. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: Casting and mirroring through Chromecast, AirPlay, Miracast and DLNA
Three Hisense smart services that the TV needs to boot
notes: Three Hisense services must never be turned off. Turning them off sent a sister model to Android Recovery.
The streaming apps and voice group is your choice. Keep the ones you use.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my Hisense TV?
faq.a: Yes. Google Assistant is kept by choice.
Yes. Chromecast, AirPlay, Miracast and DLNA are all kept.

faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns the apps back on and puts the Google TV home screen back in one tap.
